user.title: Choose provider
user.description: Choose how the integration retrieves system data.

web_api.title: Connect Web API provider
web_api.description: Choose a unique local provider ID. The connection is tested before the hub is saved. Connection and authentication data may be reused by other hubs.

esphome_native_node.title: Choose ESPHome node
esphome_native_node.description: Choose a node currently visible through mDNS, or choose manual entry. This choice only fills in the connection address; the encrypted native API and the device MAC are verified before anything is saved.

esphome_native.title: Connect ESPHome Native provider
esphome_native.description: Connect directly to the local ESPHome node through its encrypted native API. A discovered address is prefilled but remains editable. The provider ID is the stable local identity of this connection.

mqtt.title: Connect MQTT provider
mqtt.description: Connect directly to a standard MQTT 3.1.1 broker. TLS uses the system certificate store and verifies the broker hostname. No Home Assistant MQTT integration is required.

reconfigure.title: Choose provider
reconfigure.description: Keep the current provider or switch this hub to another provider. A switch keeps the system identities and mappings, but disables those systems until you have checked and re-enabled them.

reconfigure_web_api.title: Reconfigure Web API provider
reconfigure_web_api.description: The connection is tested before it is saved. When keeping the Web API provider, you may leave the password empty to retain the saved password.

reconfigure_esphome_native_node.title: Choose ESPHome node
reconfigure_esphome_native_node.description: Choose a node currently visible through mDNS, or choose manual entry to retain or replace the saved address. The encrypted native API must confirm the saved device MAC before the change is accepted.

reconfigure_esphome_native.title: Reconfigure ESPHome Native provider
reconfigure_esphome_native.description: The encrypted local connection and device identity are verified before they are saved. When keeping this provider, you may leave the encryption key empty to retain the saved key.

reconfigure_mqtt.title: Reconfigure MQTT provider
reconfigure_mqtt.description: The broker connection is tested before it is saved. Leave the password empty to retain the saved password when the username is unchanged.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate provider hub
reauth_confirm.description: The new credential is saved only after the provider connection and linked systems have been validated.

archive_week.name: Archive week
archive_week.description: Archive a completed calendar week for enabled source archives or one selected system. With no week specified, catch up on missing completed weeks. Files are stored on the HA system.
